title: Motion tween does not interpolate SymbolInstance.alpha
description: In timeline-query.ts displayObjectToTweenTarget() hardcodes alpha: 100 instead of reading the object's actual alpha value. The interpolated result.alpha is computed but never written back to the display object. An instance tweened from alpha=0.2 to alpha=1.0 shows alpha=0.2 on every tween frame. Fix: map instance.alpha * 100 in displayObjectToTweenTarget(); write back result.alpha / 100 to the instance in getTweenedFrame.
